In this lesson you will determine if a multivibrator is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
INTRODUCTIONM
You will practice troubleshooting astable, monostable and bistable multivibrators for typical faults that commonly occur.
Measuring the input signal (when applicable) and output signal quickly determines if the circuit is operating correctly.
If the circuit is faulted, measuring Vcc, checking the transistors, and measuring circuit resistances should isolate the fault.
When the fault is repaired, remember, always verify the correct operation.
